summary.text: In 2026 official statements as Treasury Chief AI Officer, Paras Malik said AI adoption is moving from experimentation to implementation and that the priority is operationalizing AI at scale. He described embedding AI into core workflows to enhance risk management and resilience, and convening regulators and industry leaders so governance frameworks evolve alongside deployment. He also said clear terminology and pragmatic risk management are essential to accelerating AI adoption, and described resources intended to reduce uncertainty and support scalable implementation. In personal and reported statements, he called AI a defining economic opportunity and said innovation should advance safely and responsibly without compromising safety and soundness.
